transcript:
Hi everyone, when I present an idea or a flow to stakeholders, I can't draw as fast as I think. Everyone has to wait while I catch up. And afterwards, the rough drawing is hard to revise or share. I thought AI could help the drawing keep up with the explanation. We could visualize our thoughts as we explain the flow. So I built Sprig.
It's a canvas first app. You explain an idea aloud and OpenAI's GPT transcribe turns your speech into text. Sprig uses that to update the diagram while you talk, share your screen in a meeting and everyone can follow the idea as it takes shape. It listens without talking back. That's Sprig. Thanks for watching.
